title: BUGFIX — Achiri timeout: send warm Derja retry message instead of generic error
rationale: 09:03 log confirmed: qwen3:4b times out at 60s during pipeline hours (Ollama saturated). telegram-bot.ts outer catch already sends a message, but it's the same generic message for all errors. Fix: detect AbortError specifically and send a warmer Derja retry message ('Sber chwaya — rasi meshghoul!') so users know the bot is busy, not broken. One surgical edit to the catch block in handleMessage().
success_criteria: AbortError / timeout sends Derja busy-message, not generic error
Other errors still send generic error message
No functional change to non-timeout paths

tasks.description: agents/achiri/telegram-bot.ts: differentiate AbortError timeout from other catch errors, send Derja retry message on timeout
